# FLX-3716: a calibrated parameter declares a held-out gap larger than its tolerance

**Family:** seam/conformance (the 3000 band)

docs/spec/PARAMETER-REGISTER-SPEC.md: an entry whose source is `calibrated` records, in calibration.heldOut, the largest gap of the held-out check and the tolerance it was held to. A value is calibrated only when it passed that check, so an entry whose largestGap is larger than its tolerance is refused. The engine does not re-run the fit: the bundle declares the held-out evidence with the digests it names, and a record that contradicts itself cannot be read as a fit that held. Nothing was written.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-3716
```
